summary: IronFlow MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed including real Gemini 3 Flash parse-plan with a JPEG workout image. Frontend: mobile viewport 375x667 — Home, Plans, Plan Create, Workout w/ rest timer, History (Séances + Stats + weekly chart), and Import screens all render correctly with proper brand-color active tab and expected testIDs. Storage flow (create plan -> plans list -> start workout -> toggle set -> rest timer modal -> skip -> finish) verified.

minor.issue: Malformed base64 returns 502 from Cloudflare (HTML body) instead of a JSON error. Behavior is 'not 200' so acceptable, but backend could catch base64 decode errors earlier and return 400 JSON.

issues: Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Use props.resizeMode' — non-blocking but should be cleaned up. resizeMode is used in styles.heroImg on Home.

action_items: (Optional) In /app/backend/server.py, wrap ImageContent creation in a try/except to catch invalid base64 and return HTTPException(400, 'Invalid image data') instead of relying on the LLM/gateway to 502.
(Optional) On Home (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx), move `resizeMode: 'cover'` from StyleSheet.heroImg into a prop on ImageBackground/Image to silence the deprecation warning.
(Optional) Replace `props.pointerEvents` usages with `style.pointerEvents` in the affected component to silence the RN Web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean and small (~180 lines); Pydantic validation used; no ObjectId leaks; env vars via os.environ; CORS OK.
parse-plan properly normalizes exercises: coerces reps to str, sets/rest_seconds to int, null-handles weight/notes.
Frontend components use testID consistently on all required interactive elements; RN primitives (View/Text/Pressable) used; StyleSheet.create used; text wrapped in <Text>.
seed_data_creation: Created one local plan 'Test Plan Pectoraux' via the UI (AsyncStorage) during testing. Not persisted on backend (local-only app).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://training-log-107.preview.emergentagent.com. testIDs verified: tab-home, tab-plans, tab-history, start-workout-btn, quick-import, quick-create, plan-title-input, add-exercise-btn, save-plan-btn, start-plan-*, toggle-set-*, rest-skip, finish-workout, tab-history-seg, tab-stats-seg, btn-camera, btn-gallery. Note: parse-plan real Gemini call takes ~4s and returns valid schema (see test_parse_plan_valid_image).
